import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { SurfaceController } from '../../controllers/surface-controller.js';
export declare class BottomSheet extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        open: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultOpen: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        title: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        description: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        initialFocusId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        returnFocusId: {
            type: StringConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        dismissOnOutside: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        body: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
    };
    open: boolean | undefined;
    defaultOpen: boolean | undefined;
    description: string;
    initialFocusId: string;
    returnFocusId: string;
    dismissOnOutside: boolean;
    body: unknown;
    private state;
    private pointerStart;
    readonly surface: SurfaceController;
    constructor();
    get committedOpen(): boolean;
    private close;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
